entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hello, Isaac... I hope you can help. I'm calling because I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. Could I start with your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF886-1130. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've always been so happy. I saved up for these new mountain bike shoes and it just hasn't worked out.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the Terra-Grip cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered about seven weeks ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats multiple times, wore different socks... but no matter what, they give me horrible blisters on my heels. I can't ride for more than an hour. I really needed these to work, and honestly, I really need that money back for other things.

I completely understand. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and it sounds like this model just isn't the right one for your foot shape. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Oh, I hope so. I was so worried it had been too long.

Not at all. I've just confirmed our policy. For standard items like these shoes, you have a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so stressed about this. You've made my day.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I've just started the return in our system. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
